overviewParagraphs: The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram Strip is Vietnam's uncontested champion — a Greg Norman masterpiece that has been ranked in Golf Digest's Top 100 Courses in the World. Sitting on a remote stretch of Vietnam's southern coastline, the course tumbles through enormous coastal sand dunes unlike anything else in Asia.

Norman himself calls it his favourite design. The layout exploits the natural terrain with relentless creativity: blind tee shots over dune ridges, platform greens carved into clifftops, and sweeping fairways that shift direction with the ocean breeze. It is physically and mentally the most demanding course in Vietnam.

Despite its remote location, the Ho Tram Strip resort provides five-star accommodation and a private airstrip for charter access. For the serious discerning golfer, The Bluffs is the defining Vietnam experience and a bucket-list course by any global standard.

curatorBriefHtml: The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram (opened 2014 on the wild coastal dunes two hours southeast of Ho Chi Minh City) is Greg Norman’s world-top-100 links-style triumph — and Southern Vietnam’s indisputable #1 golf course. Routed directly across towering natural coastal sand dunes up to 50 metres above sea level (Par 71, 7,207 yards), The Bluffs delivers rollercoaster elevation swings, sweeping 360-degree ocean-and-forest panoramas, and relentless coastal winds that make every round a thrilling adventure.

Having played The Bluffs and stayed at the adjacent InterContinental Grand Ho Tram personally, my #1 advice is to stay at least 1–2 nights on-site rather than rushing a 5-hour round-trip day drive from Saigon. Staying across the road lets you play an unhurried morning round when winds are manageable — or play 36 holes across two days to learn the slopes of signature holes like the dramatic downhill par-3 4th and hilltop 15th.
The Bluffs anchors our Saigon & Shores Escape and pairs seamlessly with Long Thanh or VGCC. Read our full breakdown in The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram Review.

scorecard.verdict: One of Greg Norman's finest global achievements. Towering coastal dunes, fierce South China Sea winds, and stunning 360-degree vistas make this a world-class bucket-list round.

faqs.q: How far is The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram from Ho Chi Minh City?
faqs.a: Allow roughly 2 hours to 2 hours 15 minutes southeast of District 1, Ho Chi Minh City by private touring vehicle. We strongly recommend an overnight stay at the InterContinental Grand Ho Tram directly across from the clubhouse rather than a single day trip.

faqs.q: Why is The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram ranked among the World's Top 100 golf courses?
faqs.a: Greg Norman routed the course across rare, massive natural seaside sand dunes with up to 50 metres of vertical elevation change — combining links-style wind and firm turf with breathtaking ocean views from the hilltop holes.

faqs.q: How windy does The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram get?
faqs.a: Coastal winds are a signature part of the test, particularly from November through March when strong northeast gusts blow across the exposed upper dunes. Morning tee times (07:30–09:00 AM) offer the calmest scoring window.

faqs.q: Can we play The Bluffs and a Saigon course on the same trip?
faqs.a: Yes — most AGS southern itineraries pair 2 nights in Ho Chi Minh City (playing VGCC, Long Thanh, or Taekwang Jeongsan) with 2 nights at Ho Tram playing The Bluffs.
